subject: Construction Manager at Risk RFQ
overview: The subcommittee coordinated the procurement schedule and reviewed draft qualification materials for a Construction Manager at Risk for the high school project. Members authorized two committee representatives to give final approval on the draft RFQ before forwarding it to the full building committee.

items.title: CMR Procurement Timeline and Meeting Scheduling
items.summary: The subcommittee reviewed the proposed procurement schedule for the Construction Manager at Risk and aligned member availability for review sessions and firm interviews across July, August, and September.

items.title: Review of Draft RFQ
items.summary: Members reviewed sections of the draft RFQ, providing revisions regarding hard copy distribution, project labor agreement language, LEED target phrasing, and criteria for evaluating past project experience.

items.title: Authorization to Finalize RFQ
items.summary: Approved a motion authorizing Jenny Graham and Kenneth Lord to incorporate member feedback via email and give final approval to send the RFQ to the full building committee.
